Job Purpose:
 



 To lead and direct Asyad Logistics’ Freight Forwarding business in Oman, ensuring profitable growth, commercial expansion, operational excellence, and strong financial control across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance activities. The role carries full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, with responsibility for driving revenue growth, margin improvement, service quality, business transformation, and disciplined working capital management including timely billing, collections, and cash flow performance. The role supports Oman’s positioning as a regional logistics hub while ensuring compliance with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance, Oman Labour Law, customs regulations, and international trade requirements.
 



  





 Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:
 


* Develop and execute the Freight Forwarding strategy, annual business plan, and budget in alignment with Asyad Logistics’ growth ambitions and national logistics objectives.
* Drive commercial expansion by winning new business, penetrating target sectors, strengthening customer relationships, and building a healthy pipeline across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance services.
* Identify and develop new products, trade lanes, customer segments, and value\-added forwarding solutions that enhance revenue, competitiveness, and market share.
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with airlines, shipping lines, overseas agents, transport partners, customs stakeholders, and key government entities to improve capability, reach, and commercial positioning.
* Lead the Freight Forwarding business to support Oman’s role as a competitive regional gateway and logistics hub.
* Ensure all strategic initiatives and business activities are aligned with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance requirements, and relevant regulatory frameworks.
* Hold full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, margin improvement, cost discipline, and delivery of agreed financial targets.
* Lead end\-to\-end Freight Forwarding operations across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance to ensure service reliability, operational excellence, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive pricing discipline, job profitability, vendor cost control, and operational efficiency to improve gross margin and EBIT performance.
* Ensure strong financial leadership across the business through timely and accurate billing, reduction of revenue leakage, disciplined credit control, proactive collections follow\-up, and close monitoring of overdue receivables and cash conversion.
* Oversee operational and commercial controls to ensure timely job closure, complete cost capture, accurate invoicing, and proper handover to finance.
* Manage key cost drivers including transport procurement, vendor agreements, subcontracted services, manpower, claims exposure, and service failures.
* Ensure full compliance with customs rules, international trade regulations, internal governance requirements, and health, safety, security, and quality standards.
* Maintain service excellence and resilience across the forwarding network while ensuring competitiveness in rates, transit times, and customer responsiveness.
* Lead business improvement initiatives to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve visibility, and raise productivity across commercial and operational functions.
* Drive transformation in areas such as digital forwarding, performance dashboards, shipment visibility, pricing governance, job costing discipline, and exception management.
* Implement performance measurement frameworks that track revenue growth, gross profit, yield, billing timeliness, collections, DSO, productivity, service quality, and customer retention.
* Improve the effectiveness of the commercial and operational interface to ensure faster quotation turnaround, better conversion, smoother execution, and stronger customer experience.
* Identify structural opportunities to improve business performance, including trade lane prioritization, customer profitability management, vendor consolidation, and operating model enhancement.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and compliance processes within Freight Forwarding operations to protect profitability and reduce operational and financial leakage.
* Lead and develop the Freight Forwarding organization, including commercial, customer service, operations, customs clearance, and support teams.
* Build a high\-performance culture centered on accountability, customer focus, commercial discipline, execution quality, and continuous improvement.
* Develop organizational capability through coaching, succession planning, performance management, and Omanization initiatives.
* Set clear performance expectations for revenue generation, profitability, billing discipline, collections support, operational delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with finance, procurement, HR, IT, QHSE, and other business units to ensure strong business execution.
* Champion ethical leadership, safety, compliance, and professional standards across the Freight Forwarding business.



  





 Minimum Qualifications and Experience
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree or MBA with focus on Supply Chain/Operations.
* Professional certifications in logistics/supply chain (e.g., CSCP, FIATA, CILT) are an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years in logistics and supply chain, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record in freight forwarding, warehousing, and transport operations with full P\&L responsibility.
* Experience in developing and executing large\-scale logistics strategies and transformation projects.



 Strong understanding of GCC and international logistics markets, compliance, and trade regulations.

data.jd_text:
We're partnering with a rapidly scaling technology business that is transforming one of the region's largest and most complex industries through AI, automation, and data\-driven innovation.
 



  





 Backed by a well\-established regional group and operating with the agility of a startup, the company is building next\-generation products that are redefining how businesses and customers interact across a highly transactional environment.
 



  





 As part of its next phase of growth, the company is seeking an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the technology function, shape engineering culture, and drive the execution of an ambitious AI\-powered product roadmap.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity for a hands\-on engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, product, and business.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the executive leadership team, you will take ownership of engineering strategy, team development, architecture, delivery excellence, and AI innovation. You will inherit a capable team and be responsible for elevating engineering standards, improving delivery velocity, and building a world\-class technology organization capable of scaling across the region.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems through technology, has experience building and scaling high\-performing engineering teams, and remains deeply involved in technical decision\-making.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Define and execute the company's engineering vision and technical strategy.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a multi\-disciplinary engineering team across multiple locations.
* Drive engineering excellence, delivery quality, and operational effectiveness across all products and platforms.
* Establish modern software development practices, CI/CD processes, testing frameworks, monitoring, and observability standards.
* Partner closely with Product and Design leadership to deliver customer\-centric solutions and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend, AI, and data platforms.
* Build and mature AI and automation capabilities, including agentic AI systems and intelligent workflow automation.
* Improve engineering productivity, release cadence, system reliability, and security posture.
* Develop strong technical leadership within the organization through coaching, succession planning, and selective hiring.
* Act as the senior technical voice within the leadership team, providing guidance on technology investments, risk management, scalability, and innovation.



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5 years leading engineering teams.
* Previous experience as a Head of Engineering, VP Engineering, CTO, Co\-Founder, or equivalent senior technology leadership role.
* Proven track record of scaling engineering organizations in high\-growth startup, scale\-up, or technology\-driven environments.
* Strong hands\-on technical background with the ability to review architecture, contribute to technical discussions, and guide engineering direction.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams across product, design, engineering, and data functions.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, cloud technologies, distributed systems, and engineering best practices.
* Experience building products in fast\-paced environments where reliability, speed, and customer experience are critical.
* Demonstrated success improving software delivery processes, engineering culture, and operational maturity.



  





 Highly Desirable
 


* Production experience with AI\-powered products, LLM applications, agentic AI systems, or intelligent automation platforms.
* Experience working within SaaS, platform businesses, marketplaces, CRM ecosystems, or transaction\-heavy environments.
* Exposure to data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and AI\-driven product development.
* Startup founder or early\-stage leadership experience.
* Experience managing distributed engineering teams.



  





 Why Join?
 


* Opportunity to shape the future of a high\-growth technology business with significant market impact.
* Direct access to executive leadership and strategic decision\-making.
* Significant ownership, influence, and autonomy.
* Meaningful equity participation.
* Well\-funded environment with long\-term growth ambitions.
* Opportunity to build industry\-leading AI products and engineering capabilities.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with the pace and excitement of a startup.



  





 This is a career\-defining opportunity for a technology leader who wants to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact on a business undergoing significant transformation.
 



  





 Location: Dubai, UAE (Onsite)
 



  





 Candidates currently based in the UAE will be highly preferred.

In this high\-impact role, you’ll operate at the intersection of growth, product, and data, leading a high\-performing team to shape how millions of users and businesses engage with and stay loyal to our products—while driving Kape’s evolution into a top global cybersecurity company.
   

  

 You will lead a team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle, pricing, and CRO, defining the next generation of retention through AI\-driven personalization, advanced experimentation, and world\-class customer journeys.

 Define \& Scale the Lifecycle Growth Strategy
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all brands, with a clear mandate to maximize LTV, reduce churn, and accelerate revenue growth. Build and execute a global roadmap spanning onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell, and winback.
   

  

 Lead a Best\-in\-Class Retention Organization
   

  

 Build, scale, and inspire a high\-performing team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle marketing, and CRO. Develop strong leadership layers, elevate talent, and foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and impact.
   

  

 Own Monetization \& Pricing Strategy
   

  

 Drive the evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization levers across multiple products. Partner closely with Product and Finance to optimize subscription models, promotions, add\-ons, and upgrade paths that maximize long\-term customer value.
   

  

 Drive AI\-Powered CRM \& Personalization
   

  

 Leverage cutting\-edge CRM platforms and AI\-driven tools to deliver highly personalized, data\-driven customer experiences at scale. Continuously evolve segmentation, targeting, and automation strategies.
   

  

 Optimize the End\-to\-End Customer Journey (CRO \& Lifecycle)
   

  

 Own the intersection of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and lifecycle marketing, ensuring seamless, high\-converting user journeys across all touchpoints—from onboarding through renewal.
   

  

 Build a Unified Retention Ecosystem
   

  

 Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to create a cohesive retention and monetization engine. Align incentives, roadmaps, and execution to deliver business impact.
   

  

 Champion Data\-Driven Growth
   

  

 Establish best\-in\-class analytics and experimentation frameworks. Deeply understand and optimize key metrics including churn, resurrection, winback, upsell, renewal rates, and LTV.
   

  

 Hands\-On Leadership in a Scaling Environment
   

  

 Operate as both a strategic leader and an execution partner—comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock teams, launch initiatives, and drive results, especially in a high\-growth or smaller company environment.

* Hands\-on operator who can execute as well as lead
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaborator across Product, Sales, Data, and Customer teams
* Clear, compelling communicator who can align and inspire at all levels

**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
   

  

 Moove’s growth has been fuelled by its global Uber partnership and support of leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, MUFG, and many others. With operations now spanning 19 cities across 6 continents \- Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and the Middle East \- Moove continues to expand its offerings through strategic acquisitions and partnerships with industry leaders, including Waymo and Uber. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. The role also leads key strategic initiatives, including new market launches, new business lines (e.g. AV), and other growth opportunities, ensuring disciplined execution from planning through implementation.
   

  

**This role is a "temp role" of 6 months.**
**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As Moove scales across markets, this role ensures consistent delivery across four core areas: business performance, project management across centrally driven initiatives, expansion, and cross\-functional execution.
   

  

 Critical outcomes (6–12 months)
   

  

* Establish a consistent performance management cadence across markets (SteerCos, dashboards, planning cycles)
* Identify and address key drivers of underperformance, improving profitability and operational efficiency
* Deliver high\-impact strategic initiatives (e.g., market launches, pricing improvements, new revenue streams)


 Scope of responsibilities \& impact areas
   

  

* Performance Management: Own weekly and monthly business reviews, track key metrics, and lead deep dives to understand performance drivers and gaps
* Strategic Planning: Lead annual budgeting, OKRs, and quarterly planning processes, ensuring alignment between company goals and market execution
* Market Support: Provide hands\-on support to local teams on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion decisions through structured analysis
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Finance, Legal, Tech, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure delivery of key priorities
* Data \& Reporting: Partner with Data/BI teams to build and maintain accurate, automated dashboards, ensuring a single source of truth and reducing manual reporting
* Central Program Management: Track and manage key strategic commitments, ensuring accountability and timely execution across teams
* Expansion \& Growth: Support and lead new market launches, new categories, and other strategic initiatives from evaluation through implementation


**What You Will Need For This Position**

* 10\-12\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles in high\-growth environments
* Strong track record of driving business performance and solving complex operational problems
* Experience working across multiple markets or regions is preferred

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and financial modeling
* Familiarity with BI tools
* Solid understanding of unit economics, cost structures, and performance drivers


 Behavioural \& Leadership Traits:
   

  

* Structured problem\-solver with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage stakeholders and influence decisions across teams
* Clear and effective communicator, including with senior leadership
* High ownership and ability to operate in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments
* Focus on execution and delivering measurable outcomes

 mprovement in core business metrics such as revenue growth, utilization, contribution margin, and cashflow
   

  

* Effectiveness of performance management processes (e.g., quality and consistency of reviews, dashboard adoption)

**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CEO Moove, and closely working with our Central OperationsTeam.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is a greenfield central securities depository being built to go\-live in 2027\.
 



  





 We are hiring a Head of Product Technology to own the technology platform end\-to\-end: the application and the infrastructure on which it runs. This is not background plumbing. The application is the product. The infrastructure is the foundation on which settlement finality, system resilience, latency performance, and operational availability are delivered. The post\-holder must understand both layers as one integrated whole and own them as one.
 



  





 In Build, the post\-holder is the architect of the platform from a blank sheet: technology reference architecture, infrastructure topology, hosting strategy, network and database design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and disaster\-recovery architecture. In Run, the same person operates the platform and the team they have designed. This is not a sit\-in\-your\-office role.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the technology reference architecture from a blank sheet: application architecture, infrastructure topology, database platform, network design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and DR architecture
* Owning the application end\-to\-end: design, configuration, integration, data model, change management, and support
* Owning the infrastructure that hosts the platform: compute, storage, network, virtualisation, database, and middleware, whether on\-premise, hosted, or cloud
* Owning platform resilience: high availability design, backup and recovery architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, and tested failover
* Owning end\-to\-end platform performance including transaction latency, capacity planning, and headroom strategy
* Owning first\-line platform security: secure configuration, hardening, identity and access management, vulnerability management, patching, and security incident response
* Owning the technical relationship with the build vendor; holding them to account on functional, technical, and operational delivery
* Designing the human operating model for the platform: team shape, shift patterns, on\-call rotations, incident command structure, runbooks, and third\-party support arrangements
* Owning all integrations between the platform and external systems: custodians, settlement banks, exchange, SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ISIN infrastructure
* Line managing the Application Managers, Database Administrator, and the wider platform engineering team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in financial\-services platform technology, with substantial time spent owning a mission\-critical platform end\-to\-end across both application and infrastructure layers. Direct, demonstrable experience architecting a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet: this is non\-negotiable. Direct, demonstrable experience as the technical authority on a CSD, custody platform, post\-trade platform, capital markets platform, or core banking system of comparable mission\-criticality: also non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Hands\-on technical credibility across both application and infrastructure layers: able to read code, query a database, design a network topology, debug an integration, and challenge a vendor's technical decisions with authority. Demonstrated experience holding a major build vendor or system integrator to account on technical delivery. Deep understanding of how a regulated financial\-services business works, not just the technology underneath it. Fluent in English.
 



  





 Experience in financial market infrastructure (CSD, CCP, exchange, or payment system) is an advantage. So is familiarity with CPMI\-IOSCO principles and experience designing SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ICSD integrations.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The platform does not exist yet. The architecture has not been designed, the infrastructure has not been built, and the operating model has not been written. The person who takes this role will have done all of it. If you have genuinely architected and owned a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet, and you have the hands\-on credibility and delivery drive to do it again, this is worth a conversation.
